hub.casual.description: Race on equal rules without risking rank.

invite.title: RACE PARTY INVITATION

legend.ban.title: LEGEND BO3 · CHARACTER BANS
legend.ban.body: Choose two characters. Slot 1 lasts the series; slot 2 applies only to game one.

legend.pick.body: Both players share the selected character. Used characters cannot repeat.
legend.pick.waiting: Waiting for the previous game's loser to choose…

sl.exhausted.title: SL allowance exhausted
sl.exhausted.body: Saving and quitting now forfeits this race. The server clock never pauses.
surrender.title: Surrender this race?
surrender.body: Confirming immediately records a loss and cannot be undone.
surrender.vote.title: Start a surrender vote?
surrender.vote.body: A strict majority of the original team must agree within 60 seconds.

auth.beta_access_required:
Spire Race is currently in closed beta. Bugs are expected and server capacity is limited, so access is available to selected players. Email spirerace@163.com to request free beta access.

You can support server costs at Afdian https://ifdian.net/a/spirerace or Ko-fi https://ko-fi.com/spirerace.

The project is open source: you may modify it or deploy your own server.
auth.server_not_connected: No race server is connected. Select one in Settings first.
auth.steam_required: Spire Race requires Steam to be running with a signed-in account.
